bodyDiameterMm.description: Cylindrical body wall diameter of the label zone, below the shoulder/neck taper.

topDiameterMm.description: Diameter at the top of the cylindrical body zone, before the shoulder taper. The body is a straight cylinder up to the shoulder, so this always equals bodyDiameterMm.

bodyHeightMm.description: Physical height of the cylindrical body/label zone only -- excludes the shoulder/neck/cap, which remain the existing ratio-derived schematic.

research.scope: Conventional 500-750ml cylindrical sports/water bottle blanks; excludes contoured/faceted bottles.
notes: The ranges are a practical modeling envelope, not an industry standard.
Shoulder/neck/cap dimensions remain the existing ObjectTemplate ratio fields (neckWidthFactor etc.), relative to this body diameter/height -- out of scope for this milestone.
